import re

def parse_demo(text):
    im=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\nDemo pair \d+ output)',text,re.S).group(1)
    out=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance)',text,re.S).group(1)
    inp=[[int(z) for z in ln.split()] for ln in im.strip().splitlines()]
    expected=[[int(z) for z in ln.split()] for ln in out.strip().splitlines()]
    return inp,expected

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Mark positions where two equal-sized panels share their common color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    splits = []
    # The separator is a uniform row or column between equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and h - r - 1 > 0 and r == h - r - 1:
            splits.append(("horizontal", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c > 0 and w - c - 1 > 0 and c == w - c - 1:
            splits.append(("vertical", c))
    if len(splits) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"expected one equal-panel separator, found {splits}")
    orientation, k = splits[0]
    if orientation == "horizontal":
        first, second = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
    else:
        first = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        second = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]

    shared = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
    if not shared:
        raise ValueError("the panels have no shared color")
    color = max(
        shared,
        key=lambda v: sum(
            first[r][c] == v and second[r][c] == v
            for r in range(len(first)) for c in range(len(first[0]))
        ),
    )
    return [
        [3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
         for c in range(len(first[0]))]
        for r in range(len(first))
    ]
'''
